project_metadata.title: 小狐狸的程式魔法
project_metadata.global_style_prompt: Digital storybook illustration, vibrant Pixar style, 3D render feel, cute anthropomorphic character design.

character_master.name: Aki
character_master.body_features: fluffy tail with a white tip

environment.key_elements: a mossy log, ancient forest trees
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: volumetric sunbeams filtering through trees, magical sparkles in the air

scenes.narration: 陽光明媚的早晨，小狐狸阿光在森林深處發現了一個神奇的發光盒子。
scenes.image_prompt: Looking curiously at a closed silver laptop computer resting on a mossy log from a distance. Wide shot.

environment.key_elements: a mossy log, ancient forest trees
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: volumetric sunbeams filtering through trees, magical sparkles in the air

scenes.narration: 他好奇地用小爪子碰了碰按鍵，螢幕突然亮了起來！
scenes.image_prompt: Touching the keyboard with a small paw, the laptop screen suddenly glows brightly, illuminating his face. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: a mossy log, ancient forest trees
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: volumetric sunbeams filtering through trees, magical sparkles in the air

scenes.narration: 阿光心想：『哇！這難道是傳說中的魔法書嗎？我也想學會這種神奇的魔法！』
scenes.image_prompt: Looking at the glowing screen with wide eyes full of wonder, the bright screen reflecting in his round glasses. Extreme close-up shot.

environment.key_elements: books and scrolls in the background

scenes.narration: 阿光找來了森林裡最聰明的貓頭鷹博士。
scenes.image_prompt: Standing next to a wise old owl wearing glasses, looking up respectfully. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: books and scrolls in the background

scenes.narration: 博士推了推眼鏡說：『這叫做寫程式喔！就像是在玩拼圖，把各種指令像積木一樣拼起來。』
scenes.image_prompt: The wise old owl showing floating colorful holographic code blocks and logic symbols. Medium-wide shot.

environment.key_elements: books and scrolls in the background

scenes.narration: 阿光聽得好認真，尾巴開心地搖來搖去。
scenes.image_prompt: Sitting and listening intently with a focused, happy expression, tail positioned as if wagging. Close-up shot.

scenes.narration: 經過好幾天的努力，阿光終於寫出了他的第一個程式！他輕輕按下『執行』鍵...
scenes.image_prompt: Looking determined, pressing a key on the glowing laptop keyboard in the dark forest. Close-up shot.

environment.key_elements: surrounding grass, a surprised little rabbit watching nearby
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: dreamlike blue light illumination, magical night atmosphere

scenes.narration: 突然，嗶嗶啵啵！螢幕裡飛出了無數隻會發光的虛擬小蝴蝶，照亮了整個夜晚的森林。
scenes.image_prompt: Cheering with joy as hundreds of glowing neon blue holographic butterflies fly out from the laptop screen, illuminating the surrounding grass. Medium shot.

environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: soft moonlight background, heartwarming and celebratory atmosphere

scenes.narration: 森林裡的小動物們都驚呼起來：『阿光，你好厲害啊！』
scenes.image_prompt: Surrounded by cheering squirrels, rabbits, and deer looking at the glowing butterflies in awe. Wide shot.

environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: soft moonlight background, heartwarming and celebratory atmosphere

scenes.narration: 阿光驕傲地挺起胸膛笑著說：『原來寫程式一點都不難，只要發揮想像力，大家都能成為創造奇蹟的魔法師呢！』
scenes.image_prompt: Standing proudly in the center smiling, holding the glowing laptop with a few lingering glowing virtual butterflies around him. Hero shot.
